title: Isovitexin Alleviates Myocardial Ischemia by Targeting SLC25A4 and Modulating the AMPK/PGC-1alpha Signaling Pathway.
authors: He, Zilu; Shan, Zaozhen; Zhou, Yi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Isovitexin通过靶向SLC25A4蛋白治疗心肌缺血，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Isovitexin (ISOV) is an active component identified in the traditional Tibetan medicine Tsantan Sumtang, which is commonly used for treating myocardial ischemia. Although previous studies have suggested the protective effect of ISOV on cardiomyocytes, the in vivo anti-ischemic efficacy and underlying mechanisms of ISOV remain unclear. This study aimed to systematically evaluate the therapeutic effects of ISOV on myocardial ischemia in rats and to elucidate its molecular mechanism of action. An acute myocardial infarction model was established in rats by ligating the left anterior descending branch (LADL) of the coronary artery. The protective effects of ISOV were assessed by measuring infarct size, serum cardiac injury biomarkers, and oxidative stress levels. Chemical proteomics using photoaffinity magnetic beads was employed to identify potential target proteins of ISOV. Molecular docking, pull-down western blotting, and cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA) western blotting were applied to validate the interaction between ISOV and target. Knockdown of the target was used to verify the mechanism of ISOV on anti-myocardial ischemia effect. ISOV treatment significantly reduced myocardial infarct size, decreased serum levels of lactate dehydrogenase (LDH), creatine kinase isoenzymes (CK-MB), malondialdehyde (MDA), and enhanced superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity in myocardial ischemia rats. Furthermore, ISOV improved mitochondrial function, as evidenced by increased ATP content and enhanced activities of mitochondrial complexes I and IV. Chemical proteomics and bioinformatic analysis identified SLC25A4 as a direct target of ISOV. Molecular docking revealed a high-affinity binding (binding energy: -8.3 kcal/mol), which was further confirmed by pull-down assays and CETSA. In SLC25A4-knockdown H9c2 cells under hypoxic conditions, ISOV upregulated SLC25A4 expression, promoted the phosphorylation of adenosine monophosphate (AMP)-activated protein kinase (AMPK) and upregulated the expression of proliferator-activated receptor gamma coactivator-1alpha (PGC-1alpha). ISOV exerts cardioprotective effects against myocardial ischemia by directly binding to SLC25A4 and activating the AMPK/PGC-1alpha pathway, highlighting its potential as a therapeutic agent for myocardial ischemia.
abstract_zh: 异荭草苷（ISOV）是传统藏药赞丹松汤中鉴定出的一种活性成分，该药常用于治疗心肌缺血。尽管先前研究表明ISOV对心肌细胞具有保护作用，但其在体内的抗缺血疗效及潜在机制尚不明确。本研究旨在系统评估ISOV对大鼠心肌缺血的治疗效果，并阐明其分子作用机制。通过结扎冠状动脉左前降支（LADL）建立大鼠急性心肌梗死模型。通过测量梗死面积、血清心脏损伤生物标志物和氧化应激水平来评估ISOV的保护作用。采用光亲和磁珠的化学蛋白质组学方法鉴定ISOV的潜在靶蛋白。应用分子对接、pull-down western blotting和细胞热位移分析（CETSA）western blotting验证ISOV与靶标之间的相互作用。通过靶标敲低验证ISOV抗心肌缺血效应的机制。ISOV治疗显著减小了心肌梗死面积，降低了心肌缺血大鼠血清中乳酸脱氢酶（LDH）、肌酸激酶同工酶（CK-MB）、丙二醛（MDA）的水平，并增强了超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性。此外，ISOV改善了线粒体功能，表现为ATP含量增加以及线粒体复合物I和IV活性增强。化学蛋白质组学和生物信息学分析鉴定出SLC25A4为ISOV的直接靶标。分子对接显示高亲和力结合（结合能：-8.3 kcal/mol），并通过pull-down实验和CETSA进一步确认。在缺氧条件下的SLC25A4敲低H9c2细胞中，ISOV上调SLC25A4表达，促进腺苷一磷酸（AMP）激活蛋白激酶（AMPK）的磷酸化，并上调过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ共激活因子-1α（PGC-1alpha）的表达。ISOV通过直接结合SLC25A4并激活AMPK/PGC-1alpha通路发挥抗心肌缺血的保护作用，凸显其作为心肌缺血治疗药物的潜力。
